classification: bounded experimental local model; not fully validated plant
identified: local control effectiveness and effective lag; yaw lag is torque-path effective lag, not motor time constant
limitations: Pitch raw acceleration prediction fails and cross-flight effectiveness differs by 25 percent.
Yaw training block uncertainty is broad.
Projected instrumental moment agreement is not raw acceleration prediction.
ADRC observer is computed, but disturbance is not independently subtracted: INDI already compensates acceleration.
MRAC remains normalized, projected and frozen during clipping; useful adaptation is not established.
reason_for_40ms: RPM motor response supports 40-50 ms; exploratory 25 ms effective-body fit was not used as physical motor lag.
